Record Class ProductRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.vitallogix.backend.dto.ProductRequest
public record ProductRequest(@NotBlank(message="Name is required") String name, String code, String description, String imageUrl, String category, @NotNull(message="Price is required") @DecimalMin(value="0.00",message="Price must be >= 0") BigDecimal price, @NotNull(message="Stock is required") @Min(value=0L,message="Stock must be >= 0") Integer stock, boolean requiresPrescription, boolean visibleInSuggestions, String promotionType, Integer promoBuyQuantity, Integer promoPayQuantity, BigDecimal promoPercentDiscount, LocalDateTime expirationDate) extends Record
DTO de entrada validado para crear o actualizar un producto en la tabla MySQL products.
